options.name: The Corridor of Unlived Lives
options.story_approach: A traveler crosses an impossible corridor of doors revealing alternate lives, losses, futures, and finally the self behind all choices.
options.rendering_route: Cinematic surreal realism with monumental architecture, dark wood and brass, dimensional door light, layered 2.5D depth, atmosphere, practical-light motion, and authored threshold transitions.

storyboard.description: A single illuminated door stands without a wall in a black landscape.
The first threshold reveals an endless corridor lined with mismatched doors.
Opening doors reveal alternate worlds and alternate selves while the corridor becomes unstable.
A plain handleless door survives after the corridor disappears.
The final opening collapses all previous worlds inward around the traveler.

options.name: Threshold City
options.story_approach: A rain-soaked city grows impossible doors in transit stations, walls, intersections, and moving vehicles; each threshold rearranges reality.
options.rendering_route: Grounded urban magical realism with wet streets, reflections, fog, practical city light, impossible architecture, and physically motivated camera movement.

storyboard.description: A freestanding door waits on an empty midnight train platform.
The city subtly rearranges itself after the first crossing.
Doors appear beneath water, in buses, alley walls, and skyscrapers.
A familiar front door stands alone in a frozen rainy intersection.

options.name: The Inner Archive
options.story_approach: The thousand doors are structures inside one mind: memories, fears, dreams, identities, and forgotten selves reorganizing into integration.
options.rendering_route: Experimental painterly abstraction using silhouettes, paper, smoke, pigment, glass, constellations, reactive geometry, temporal texture locking, and audio-driven internal motion.

storyboard.description: A dark human silhouette floats with one small glowing door inside the chest.
Rooms made from handwritten pages and memory fragments pour out.
Hundreds of doors multiply across the body and surrounding void.
The archive storm collapses to one key and one point of light before integration.

user_selection.recorded_user_instruction: User approved the recommendation: Route 1 is the primary visual world and Route 3's Inner Archive treatment is incorporated into the climax.

production_direction.chat_preview_policy: internal proofs only unless user explicitly requests preview or file
